def transform(grid):
    # Each colored seed pattern tiles its surrounding rectangular zero field.
    from collections import defaultdict
    H,W=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    cells=defaultdict(list)
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            if grid[r][c] not in (0,8): cells[grid[r][c]].append((r,c))
    for color, pts in cells.items():
        r0=min(r for r,c in pts); r1=max(r for r,c in pts)
        c0=min(c for r,c in pts); c1=max(c for r,c in pts)
        ph,pw=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
        # Seed is a motif; repeat it periodically across connected zero region bounded by 8.
        # Identify all zero cells in the same rectangular region aligned with seed.
        # Expand bounding box through zeros, stopping at 8.
        top,bottom,left,right=r0,r1,c0,c1
        while top>0 and all(grid[top-1][c]!=8 for c in range(left,right+1)): top-=1
        while bottom+1<H and all(grid[bottom+1][c]!=8 for c in range(left,right+1)): bottom+=1
        while left>0 and all(grid[r][left-1]!=8 for r in range(top,bottom+1)): left-=1
        while right+1<W and all(grid[r][right+1]!=8 for r in range(top,bottom+1)): right+=1
        for r in range(top,bottom+1):
            for c in range(left,right+1):
                if grid[r][c]==0 and grid[r][c]!=8 and ((r-r0)%ph,(c-c0)%pw) in {(a-r0,b-c0) for a,b in pts}:
                    out[r][c]=color
    return out
PY
